guards: Require exact workspace, script name, input size and SHA256; pin and verify all saved proof files before opening original.
Check normal ancestors, real paths, regular files and single hard links; root execution precheck must additionally reject Windows ReparsePoint attributes.
Reject an existing output directory; never replace a previous inspection.
Require PE64 AMD64, fixed image base, bounded header/section reads and a unique readable nonexecutable file-backed section for each of the four exact reads.
Read through one read-only descriptor; compare before/after SHA256 and descriptor/path stats, then close the descriptor even on failure.
Do not read skipped slots08/20, function bodies, other original files, player saves or Steam cloud; do not execute the original, start a backend, install or alter security settings.
limitations: Old dumpbin instruction evidence is supplemental static evidence, not Rea decompilation.
Only Actor-base constructor candidates are requested. Later derived writes may replace the vptr at Entity+38.
Executable-section classification does not establish a function boundary or callable implementation.
Before/after same-descriptor hashes are not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
This plan is not execution approval. Root must review and formally run the fixed reader; no reader invocation is performed during preparation.
